17 × 23 = 391

**How I calculated this:**

17 × 23 can a couple of ways — and I'd like to show a couple of them so you can actually see how it works, so I'll show you what I mean:

**Method 1: Traditional column multiplication**

```
   17
 × 23
 -----
   51    ← 17 × 3 (units digit of 23)
  34 × 10 = 340   ← 17 × 2 (tens digit of 23, shifted left one place)
 -----
   391
```
